description:
Introducing the Ape Ryder Loris—the ultimate folding e-bike designed for urban commuters who need convenience without sacrificing performance. Built for the fast-paced lifestyle of city dwellers, the Loris offers a perfect blend of mobility, power, and comfort, making it ideal for everyday commuting and quick getaways.
Compact and Convenient Design:The 20” alloy frame is not only strong and durable but also folding, allowing you to easily store and transport the Loris. Whether you're commuting to work, navigating busy streets, or hopping on public transportation, the folding capability ensures you can carry and store your e-bike effortlessly.
Powered for the Urban Explorer:Equipped with a 48V 14Ah battery, the Loris offers an extended range of 70-85 km, making it perfect for daily commutes or weekend city adventures. You'll have the freedom to ride longer without worrying about frequent charging, making it a reliable choice for urban travel.
Efficient Motor and Speed:The 250W motor provides just the right balance of power for urban commuting, allowing you to conquer city streets with ease. With a top speed of 20 MPH, the Loris ensures you're moving swiftly through traffic while staying within legal speed limits for electric bikes.
Comfort for Your Daily Ride:Designed for city riders, the sport saddle offers both comfort and support, ideal for your everyday trips to work, school, or shopping. Whether you're riding short distances or spending more time in the saddle, the Loris ensures a comfortable experience throughout.
Safe and Responsive Braking:The dual hydraulic brake system provides powerful stopping power, ensuring maximum safety in urban environments where quick stops might be necessary. Whether you're navigating busy intersections or riding in unpredictable conditions, the Loris offers precise control when you need it most.
Perfect Tires for the City:Fitted with Kenda 20” x 4.5 tires, the Loris offers excellent traction and stability on smooth city roads. Whether you're riding over pavement, cobblestones, or through the occasional park, these tires ensure a smooth and steady ride.
Lightweight and Practical:At just 35 kg, the Loris is light enough to carry and maneuver, making it perfect for urban living. With a maximum weight capacity of 120 kg, it’s strong enough to support you and your daily essentials, whether you're heading to work or picking up groceries.
Your Ideal Urban Companion:The Ape Ryder Loris is more than just an e-bike—it's a versatile, folding, and commuter-friendly solution designed to meet the demands of modern city life. Whether you're storing it in a small apartment, taking it on public transport, or riding through crowded streets, the Loris is the perfect blend of practicality and style.
Experience urban mobility at its best with the Ape Ryder Loris—compact, powerful, and built for the city.
